page.overview:
Who is Darunia?

Living in Goron City within Death Mountain, Darunia is the patriarch of the Gorons in . He is a strict leader who sees the greater cause behind initial problems and solutions. During Link's childhood, Ganondorf, the king of the Gerudo tribe (and human form of Ganon), visited the Gorons shortly before the young hero did, and demanded that they give him the Spiritual Stone of Fire, also known as the Goron's Ruby, itself one of the three Spiritual Stones Link must obtain for Princess Zelda. If the Gorons would not hand over the sacred gem, he would keep the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern, their main source of food, closed. Despite that this would mean that the Gorons would starve to death, Darunia did not give the stone to Ganondorf, knowing that it was too important. However, because the Goron species' main diet is rocks, the Goron's Ruby also became more and more delicious-looking to the now-hungry Gorons. To protect the pink gem entrusted to the Goron race, Darunia locked himself up in his room with the Spiritual Stone, stating that he would wait there for the messenger of the Royal Family of Hyrule.

When Link arrived, he was informed of this by the other Gorons. He then went to Darunia's room and played Zelda's Lullaby. Darunia recognized this sign and opened the door, only to be enraged by the fact that the Royal Family's messenger was a mere boy, and refused to talk with him about the Goron's Ruby. The young hero played the song for Darunia, causing the latter to lose his depression and break out in a fit of dancing. Despite this, Darunia was still unwilling to give up the Goron's Ruby and challenged Link to prove his worth by destroying the monsters inside of Dodongo's Cavern. As a small bit of help, he gave Link the Goron Bracelet, which allows him to lift Bomb Flowers.

Link, with his heroic deeds, passed the test and defeated King Dodongo. When he left the cavern, Darunia was waiting for him. He happily thanked and congratulated Link for what he had done for himself and his people (and comically patting the hero hard enough to knock him to the ground). He then asked Link to become his Sworn Brother, symbolized by giving him the Spiritual Stone of Fire.
